name: connectonion
tagline_zh: 多智能体协作常卡在接口混乱、消息丢失？ConnectOnion 用洋葱式分层路由，让每个 Agent 只认邻居。
tagline_en: Tired of tangled agent handoffs? ConnectOnion layers routing like an onion—each agent talks only to its neighbor.
desc_en: The Best AI Agent Framework for Agent Collaboration.
why_zh: 别家靠中心调度，它让 Agent 自发成网；每层只传必要信息，故障隔离，扩展不炸。
why_en: Unlike hub-and-spoke, it builds a self-organizing mesh; each layer carries only what's needed, isolating failures and scaling.
